title: Design System: Riman Fashion - The Couture Atelier
note: Regenerated from src/index.css @theme, which is the canonical source. The previous version described a retired system (Plus Jakarta Sans, Playfair Display, #D4AF37, onyx #0A0A0A) and was actively misleading.

onyx.purpose: Primary dark ground: hero, interstitials, CTA band, footer, mobile nav.

champagne.purpose: Warm light ground for plates, testimonials, forms.

stone-500.purpose: Muted text on light surfaces (5.03:1 on ivory).

stone-900.purpose: Second dark surface, for variety against onyx.

terracotta.purpose: Hairlines, focus rings, badges, button fills. 4.98:1 on bone, 3.26:1 on onyx.

terracotta-light.purpose: Accent text on dark surfaces (4.50:1 on onyx). Large/label use only.

terracotta-dark.purpose: Accent text on light surfaces (7.44:1 on bone). Fails on dark - use brass-light there.

brass.purpose: Rare ornament only: ghost-button rule, jewelry gradient. 2.58:1 on light - never body text.

brass-light.purpose: Ornament text on dark surfaces (8.67:1 on onyx).

brass-ink.purpose: Brass when it must be text on a light surface (5.09:1 on ivory).

display.purpose: Headings and chapter titles. Prata 400 only - font-light is a no-op. Large headings are mixed case; short brand marks are uppercase with wide tracking.

editorial.purpose: Italic accents and pull quotes. Newsreader. Never body paragraphs, never uppercase.

body.purpose: Paragraphs and running text. Newsreader 400, leading-relaxed / leading-loose, capped at max-w-2xl.

label.purpose: Navigation, badges, metadata, eyebrows. Archivo 300-500, uppercase, 11-12px, tracking 0.25em-0.45em. 11px is the hard floor (14px in RTL).

arabic-body.purpose: Cairo / IBM Plex Sans Arabic. RTL swaps body to Cairo 500.

arabic-heading.purpose: Amiri 700 in RTL. Prata must never render Arabic.

elevation.rule: Flat by default. Depth comes from tonal contrast and spacing, never box-shadow. 1px hairlines in stone-200, terracotta/15-40, or bone/5-10 on dark.

motion.name: ease-couture
motion.purpose: The only easing curve in the system.

motion.name: duration-press
motion.purpose: Press feedback - deliberately faster than hover.

shape.radius: 0 everywhere, enforced globally with border-radius: 0 !important. rounded-full has no effect - do not add it.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Primary CTA. Stone-800 hairline and label; fills stone-800 on hover and the label turns ivory, with a champagne sheen.
components.css: .btn-luxury { px-10 py-4; font-label 12px uppercase; letter-spacing 0.25em; 1px stone-800 hairline; scaleX fill wipes from the inline-start edge, mirrored in RTL; 1px lift; 180ms press at scale(0.985). }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary CTA. Stone-400/60 border, stone-700 label; 12% terracotta tint wipe on hover.
components.css: .btn-luxury-outline { px-8 py-3; font-label 12px uppercase; letter-spacing 0.25em; 1px stone-400/60 border; terracotta tint wipe from the inline-start edge, mirrored in RTL. }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Over imagery. No fill, no border. A brass rule under the label sweeps from scaleX(.35) to full.
components.css: .btn-couture-ghost { min-h 52px; no fill; no border; brass 1px rule under the label; pair with !text-bone on dark. }

components.name: Dark Band CTA
components.description: Primary CTA on a dark band. Terracotta fill with a bone label - never onyx, which fails at 3.26:1.
components.css: .bg-terracotta { background #A2492B; color #EFEAE2; min-height 56px; padding-inline 3rem; hover background #7A3520. }

components.name: Couture Link
components.description: Inline text link with a terracotta underline that scales from 0.25 to 1.
components.css: .link-couture { font-label uppercase; letter-spacing 0.25em -> 0.32em on hover; terracotta underline scaleX(.25) -> 1; transform-origin flips to right in RTL. }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Borderless with a bottom hairline only. Focus recolours the bottom border to terracotta and adds the 2px terracotta outline.
components.css: input { background transparent; border 0; border-bottom 1px stone-300; padding 0.85rem 0.25rem; 400ms colour transition; focus outline 2px terracotta offset 2px. }

components.name: Product Card
components.description: 3:4 image with a look-number badge at the inline-start corner, fabric line, availability chip for rentals. Quick-add bar is de-emphasised and appears on hover or tap.
components.css: .card-couture { 1px stone-200 border; transparent; image zooms 1.04 over 1200ms. }

components.name: Editorial Plate
components.description: Numbered silhouette plate. Ghost numeral behind, image in 7 columns with a clip-path wipe reveal, caption in 5 columns overlapping the image edge on a champagne panel.
components.css: EditorialPlate { clip-path inset(0 0 100% 0) -> 0 over 1.2s, direction alternates per reverse and flips in RTL; ghost numeral parallax at a different rate than the image; no shadow. }

components.name: Chapter Label
components.description: Chapter opener. Ghost roman numeral in stone-200, a 40px terracotta hairline, then the KineticHeading title.
components.css: ChapterLabel { numeral font-heading text-6xl md:text-8xl text-stone-200; 40px terracotta hairline; title font-heading text-3xl md:text-5xl normal-case. }

components.name: Invitation Rule
components.description: Divider between chapters that ends in a path to /appointment. 96px terracotta hairline, italic line, arrow link.
components.css: InvitationRule { 96px terracotta hairline; Newsreader italic line; arrow link to /appointment. }

components.name: Calligraphic Accent
components.description: Arabic word used as art, not decoration filler. Amiri at clamp(5rem,12vw,11rem), terracotta-dark/5 on light and up to 20% on dark. aria-hidden.
components.css: CalligraphicAccent { font-arabic-heading; text-terracotta-dark/5; aria-hidden; pointer-events none. }

narrative.overview: A private fitting room by candlelight: warm black, bone paper, brass and rust ornament. A Sharjah couture house since 2011 - bridal, evening and rental - where every chapter should end in an invitation to a private viewing.
keyCharacteristics: Craft over flash - ornament serves structure
Heritage made present through modern type and motion
Accent rarity: brass and terracotta together stay under 10% of any screen

rules.name: The Accent Rarity Rule
rules.body: Brass and terracotta together occupy no more than 10% of any screen. Hairlines, numerals, small labels, one CTA. Never a large fill, never body text, never gradient text.

rules.name: The Warm-Black Rule
rules.body: No #000 and no #fff. Dark surfaces are onyx #0F0D0A; light surfaces are bone #EFEAE2, champagne #F6F0E6 or pearl #E8E3D9.

rules.name: The Contrast Rule
rules.body: Text on light uses terracotta-dark, brass-ink or stone-600 and above. Text on dark uses brass-light, terracotta-light (large/label only) or bone. Terracotta-dark on onyx is 2.18:1 - never.

rules.name: The Scale Rule
rules.body: Pair huge Prata display type with tiny tracked Archivo labels. Scale contrast is the cure for a flat, template-like page.

rules.name: The Editorial Rule
rules.body: Newsreader italic marks one word or a short phrase inside a heading, or a pull quote. Never body text, never uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from tonal contrast and spacing, never box-shadow.

rules.name: The RTL Rule
rules.body: In Arabic, headings render in Amiri 700, body in Cairo 500, all letter-spacing is forced to 0, type scales up 25-30%, and Arabic is never letter-split.

rules.name: The Motion Rule
rules.body: Every easing route through cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1). Reveals run 600-900ms, image hover 1200-1600ms, press 180ms. Transform and opacity only.

dos: Do alternate dark and light chapters: onyx, stone-900, champagne, bone, pearl.
Do use onyx #0F0D0A and bone #EFEAE2 as the backbone.
Do keep accents under 10% of a screen: hairlines, numerals, labels, one CTA.
Do pair huge Prata with tiny tracked Archivo labels.
Do use Newsreader italic for one word or a quote.
Do use logical CSS properties (start-*, end-*, ps-*, me-*) and mirror arrow directions in RTL.
Do end chapters with a path to /appointment.
Do provide a reduced-motion static twin of every animation.
donts: Don't use terracotta or brass as a large fill, body text, or gradient text.
Don't use #000, #fff, border-radius, box-shadow as default surface treatment, or glassmorphism as decoration.
Don't add bounce, float, ambient shimmer, or springs on brand surfaces.
Don't animate layout properties or letter-spacing on long labels.
Don't letter-split Arabic. Don't render Prata for Arabic.
Don't add stat counters, icon journey rows, or auto-rotating carousels.
Don't autoplay new heavy video above the fold or ship un-lazy images.
Don't use #D4AF37 - the retired gold. The brass is #B08D57.
Don't hard-code visible strings - every string needs an en and an ar key.
